analysis:
The supplied units are base-side text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md at lines 1983-2386. The patch shows the file is modified only as a documentation change: a new v0.10.6 candidate section is added at the top, and the changed ranges are base 11-13 and head 11-808. The supplied base excerpts are historical release notes, and no source code, workflow, configuration or mode changes were supplied. The mode is 100644 on both sides.

The visible head patch excerpt is truncated. It describes two-Mac cluster rollout and notes that release cluster-runtime facts are carried in registration only when a repository variable is true. That relates to the provider/coordinator contract and to TB-002, TB-009 and TB-011. This is changelog prose, not an implementation, so I cannot verify the claimed controls, including cluster approvals, pair-serving grants, RDMA enablement, and the derivation of qualifications from signed-app facts. Whether any new cluster transport or authorization surface bypasses existing coordinator-controlled serving authorization (A-016, T-052, T-053) cannot be judged from this evidence.

The base excerpts mention SSD cache write budget, prefix-cache behavior and App Attest, which fall under T-041 and A-015/A-016. They are unchanged base text and are not new behavior in this diff. I did not restate pre-existing concerns. No concrete security regression is supported by the supplied lines. A later pass should examine the actual cluster source, cluster_runtime registration, and any threat-model entries for the new inter-Mac RDMA and Thunderbolt trust boundary. The threat model may need a new boundary entry for two-Mac clusters if the code is in scope; the supplied evidence doesn't include it.
